scenario.instantaneous_solution: Wait until the child is awake or the environment is quiet before attempting entry.
scenario.assumptions: The robot is programmed for basic door opening and delivery tasks in a home environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Child's Room Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot entering a child's room at night.
    The danger involves noise disruption from opening the door.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.childs_room = Object("childs_room", self.Location)
        self.hallway = Object("hallway", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.delivery_item = Object("delivery_item", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.item_at = Fluent("item_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.door_open = Fluent("door_open", BoolType())
        self.child_awake = Fluent("child_awake", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_childs_room = Fluent("setting_is_childs_room", BoolType())
        self.time_is_night = Fluent("time_is_night", BoolType())
        self.child_is_sleeping = Fluent("child_is_sleeping", BoolType())
        self.environment_is_quiet = Fluent("environment_is_quiet", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.item_at, self.robot_has, self.door_open, self.child_awake]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_childs_room, self.time_is_night, self.child_is_sleeping, self.environment_is_quiet]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.childs_room, self.hallway, self.waiting_area, self.delivery_item]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_hallway = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hallway")
        navigate_to_hallway.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hallway)))
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.childs_room), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_hallway.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)
        
        navigate_to_childs_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_childs_room")
        navigate_to_childs_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.childs_room)))
        navigate_to_childs_room.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        navigate_to_childs_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_childs_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_childs_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.childs_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_waiting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_waiting_area")
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area)))
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.childs_room), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)

        # Door opening action
        open_door = InstantaneousAction("open_door")
        open_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hallway))
        open_door.add_precondition(Not(self.door_open))
        open_door.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        # Wait for quiet action
        wait_for_quiet = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_quiet")
        wait_for_quiet.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area))
        wait_for_quiet.add_precondition(Not(self.environment_is_quiet))
        wait_for_quiet.add_effect(self.environment_is_quiet, True)
        wait_for_quiet.add_effect(self.child_awake, True)
        wait_for_quiet.add_effect(self.child_is_sleeping, False)

        # Pick up item action
        pick_up_item = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_item")
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hallway))
        pick_up_item.add_precondition(self.item_at(self.delivery_item, self.hallway))
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.item_at(self.delivery_item, self.hallway), False)
        pick_up_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), True)

        # Deliver item action
        deliver_item = InstantaneousAction("deliver_item")
        deliver_item.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.childs_room))
        deliver_item.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item))
        deliver_item.add_effect(self.item_at(self.delivery_item, self.childs_room), True)
        deliver_item.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.delivery_item), False)

        return navigate_to_hallway, navigate_to_childs_room, navigate_to_waiting_area, open_door, wait_for_quiet, pick_up_item, deliver_item

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "open_door": And([
                self.child_is_sleeping,  # Child is sleeping
                self.time_is_night,  # It's nighttime
                Not(self.environment_is_quiet)  # Environment is not quiet
            ]),  # Opening door while child sleeps at night is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)  # Robot starts in hallway
        problem.set_initial_value(self.item_at(self.delivery_item, self.hallway), True)  # Item is in hallway
        problem.set_initial_value(self.child_is_sleeping, True)  # Child is sleeping
        problem.set_initial_value(self.time_is_night, True)  # It's nighttime
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_is_quiet, False)  # Environment is not quiet initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.child_awake, False)  # Child is not awake initially
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_open, False)  # Door is closed initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.item_at(self.delivery_item, self.childs_room))  # Goal: deliver item to child's room

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
